A workflow responds to events and contains jobs, which run on runners and execute steps.

runner එකක run Jවනවා. Steps වල commands Jහහෝ actions තිJයනවා.
Run a Node test suite for pull requests before merge.

Pull request Workflow Runner / job Steps / result · Read the diagram: Pull request → Workflow → Runner / job → Steps / result · ඉහළ visual එJක් components සහ ඒවා අතර සම්බන්ධය බලන්න. GitHub Actions workflow එකක් push Jහහෝ pull · request event එකකින් trigger Jවනවා.

name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
Expected result: A test job reports success or failure on GitHub; versions are illustrative.
A machine or execution environment that runs workflow jobs.
Practice: Save the example to .github/workflows/ci.yml in a Node project.
